operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a new **unit template** — a units-of-measure template with a base unit and one or more conversion factors (sub-units).

Real path: `POST /v2/api/entity/unit_template`.

The request body is a flat object. **No field is enforced by the API** — an empty body returns `200` and stores a blank template — but a meaningful template should send `template_name`, `main_unit_name`, `unit_small_name`, and at least one `unit_templates_unit_factors` row. Omitted text fields are stored as empty string / `null`, and `active` defaults to `0`. `branch_id` and `staff_id` are assigned automatically (to the active branch and current staff) and normally should be omitted.

**Sub-units (conversion factors):** send them under the `unit_templates_unit_factors` array. Each row defines a derived unit via `factor_name`, `small_name`, and the numeric `factor` (its multiplier relative to the base unit).

> The sub-unit array key must be **`unit_templates_unit_factors`**. A body that sends the children under `unit_factors` is accepted (the parent still saves and returns `200`) but the sub-rows are **silently ignored**.

On success the new template id is returned.

template_name.description: The template's display name. Not enforced, but should be sent — stored as an empty string when omitted.

active.description:
Whether the template is active. Defaults to `0` when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive (default) |
| 1 | Active |

main_unit_name.description: Name of the base unit (e.g. `gram`). Stored as an empty string when omitted.

unit_small_name.description: Short symbol for the base unit (e.g. `g`). Stored as `null` when omitted.

branch_id.description: Optional. Assigned automatically to the active branch when omitted.

staff_id.description: Optional. Assigned automatically to the current staff when omitted.

unit_templates_unit_factors.description: The sub-units (conversion factors). Each row defines one derived unit. Send `factor_name`, `small_name`, and the numeric `factor` per row (do not send `id` on create).

factor.description: Multiplier relative to the base unit (e.g. `1000`).

id.description: The id of the newly created template.

400.description: The record could not be saved — e.g. a `NOT NULL` column such as `template_name` was sent explicitly as `null`.

e.description: Diagnostic details about the failure (may be an empty array when no structured detail is available).

error.description: Human-readable description of why the save failed.
